senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (तकति)
1 To laugh at or deride.
2 To bear.
With वि and अति prefixed, and implying reciprocity
(ष्यतितकते)
To retort a laugh.
(इ) तकि r. 1st cl. (तङ्कति)
To live in distress, to be in poverty or pain.
(तंकते)
To go, to move.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
That.
E.
तत् that, कन् pleonasm added.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat.
f. (-ला)
A medicament, a drug.
E.
तक to deride, affix इलच्

mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
1 Laughable, ridiculous.
2 To be borne or endured.
E.
तक to laugh, यत् participial aff.

n. (-क्रं)
Buttermilk with a fourth part water.
E.
तक to bear (sickness), Uṇādi affix रक्.

f. (-का)
Inspissated buttermilk.
E.
तक्र, and कूर्च्चिका inspissated milk.

n. (-सं)
Meat fried with ghee, turmeric and asafœtida, &c. eaten with buttermilk.
E.
तक्र, and मांस flesh.

m. (-टः)
A churning-stick.
E.
तक्र buttermilk, and अट what goes or is, (from it.)

r. 1st cl. (तक्षति)
1 To cover.
2 To skin or peel.
(ऊ) तक्षू r. 1st cl. (तक्ष्णोति)
To pare, to plane, to make thin, to cut off, to chip or slice;
used in any other sense, this root takes the regular form only, whether simple or compound, as with सम् prefixed,
To censure, (सन्तक्षति,) &c.

m. (-कः)
1 A carpenter.
2 The Sūtradhāra, the manager and chief actor in the prelude of a drama.
3 One of the principal Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla.
4 The divine artist, VIŚVAKARMA.
5 The name of a tree.
E.
तक्ष to chip, to peel or plane, &c. affix वुन्.

n. (-णं)
Paring, peeling, planing, &c.
f. (-णी)
A carpenter's adze.
E.
तक्ष to plane or pare, affix ल्युट् and ङीष्.

m. (-क्षा)
A carpenter.
E.
तक्ष to pare, Uṇādi affix कनिन्.

f. (-ला)
The name of a city, the Taxila of Ptolemy, in the Punjab.
E.
तक्ष paring, शिला stone, built of hewn stones.
